## Revision Portal: US Math Grade 6-8
Welcome, students! This dedicated academic portal provides core textbooks, curriculum guides, and practice materials for US Middle School Mathematics (covering Grades 6, 7, and 8) aligned with the Common Core State Standards.
:::

## 1. Introduction

US Middle School Mathematics (Grades 6-8) forms the critical bridge between elementary arithmetic and high school algebra and geometry. The curriculum is structured to build robust problem-solving skills, critical thinking, and mathematical modeling.

### Key Conceptual Areas:
- **Grade 6**: Focuses on ratios and rates, rational numbers, basic algebraic expressions/equations, and introductory statistical thinking.
- **Grade 7**: Emphasizes proportional relationships, operations with rational numbers, linear expressions and equations, and geometric constructions.
- **Grade 8**: Prepares students for algebra through linear equations and functions, exponents and scientific notation, the Pythagorean theorem, and congruence/similarity.

Whether you are preparing for standard school exams, middle-school assessments, or private school entrance exams, K-Education Hub compiles the best resources to support your academic pathway.

## 4. Regents Past Papers

*Search and filter official New York Regents state exam papers. Use the control panel below to filter by exam year and middle school grade level:*

::: {.search-engine-box}
### NY Regents Mathematics (Grade 6-8) Past Papers List

```{=html}
<div class="card p-3 mb-4 shadow-sm" style="border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); background: var(--bs-card-bg, #ffffff);">
  <div class="card-body p-0">
    <div class="d-flex align-items-center flex-wrap gap-4">
      
      <!-- Year Select Dropdown -->
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2" style="min-width: 180px;">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Year:</span>
        <select id="filter-year" class="form-select form-select-sm" onchange="selectYearDropdown()" style="max-width: 130px; display: inline-block;">
          <option value="">All Years</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      
      <!-- Vertical Divider on desktop -->
      <div class="d-none d-md-block" style="border-left: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); height: 24px;"></div>
      
      <!-- Grade Pills -->
      <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-2 flex-grow-1">
        <span style="font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bs-body-color); white-space: nowrap;">Grade:</span>
        <div id="grade-pills" class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-1">
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary smart-grade-btn active" data-grade="" onclick="selectGrade(this)">All Grades</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-grade-btn" data-grade="grade 6" onclick="selectGrade(this)">Grade 6</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-grade-btn" data-grade="grade 7" onclick="selectGrade(this)">Grade 7</button>
          <button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary smart-grade-btn" data-grade="grade 8" onclick="selectGrade(this)">Grade 8</button>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="past-papers-table-container">
  <p><i class="bi bi-hourglass-split"></i> Loading past papers...</p>
</div>

<script>
let pastPapersDb = [];
let currentSelectedYear = '';
let currentSelectedGrade = '';
let currentPage = 1;
const pageSize = 10;
let filteredExams = [];

async function loadPastPapersDb() {
  if (pastPapersDb.length > 0) return pastPapersDb;
  try {
    const response = await fetch('regents_g68_metadata.json');
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Network response was not ok');
    pastPapersDb = await response.json();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to load past papers metadata:', error);
  }
  return pastPapersDb;
}

function populateYearDropdown(db) {
  const yearSelect = document.getElementById('filter-year');
  if (!yearSelect) return;

  const years = new Set();
  db.forEach(item => {
    if (item.year) {
      years.add(item.year.toString().trim());
    }
  });

  const sortedYears = Array.from(years).sort((a, b) => parseInt(b) - parseInt(a));

  yearSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">All Years</option>';
  sortedYears.forEach(year => {
    const option = document.createElement('option');
    option.value = year;
    option.textContent = year;
    yearSelect.appendChild(option);
  });
}

function renderTableData() {
  const tableBody = document.getElementById('past-papers-table-body');
  const paginationContainer = document.getElementById('pagination-controls');
  if (!tableBody) return;

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(filteredExams.length / pageSize);
  if (currentPage > totalPages) currentPage = Math.max(1, totalPages);

  const start = (currentPage - 1) * pageSize;
  const end = start + pageSize;
  const pageItems = filteredExams.slice(start, end);

  let html = '';
  pageItems.forEach(exam => {
    // Capitalize Grade Label
    const gradeLabel = exam.level.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + exam.level.slice(1);

    let qpHtml = '';
    if (exam.qp) {
      qpHtml = `<a href="${exam.qp}" target="_blank" title="Download Question Paper" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary bi bi-file-earmark-text" style="padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; width: 32px; height: 32px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6 0%, #2563eb 100%); border: none;"></a>`;
    } else {
      qpHtml = `<span class="text-muted" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">N/A</span>`;
    }

    let msHtml = '';
    if (exam.ms) {
      msHtml = `<a href="${exam.ms}" target="_blank" title="Download Scoring Key" class="btn btn-sm btn-success bi bi-key" style="padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 6px; width: 32px; height: 32px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981 0%, #059669 100%); border: none;"></a>`;
    } else {
      msHtml = `<span class="text-muted" style="font-size: 0.85rem;">N/A</span>`;
    }

    html += `
      <tr>
        <td><strong>${exam.year}</strong></td>
        <td><span class="badge badge-paper" style="background: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1); color: #2563eb; border: 1px solid rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.2); text-transform: none; font-size: 0.85rem;">${gradeLabel}</span></td>
        <td style="text-align: center;">${qpHtml}</td>
        <td style="text-align: center;">${msHtml}</td>
      </tr>
    `;
  });
  tableBody.innerHTML = html;

  if (totalPages <= 1) {
    paginationContainer.innerHTML = '';
    return;
  }

  let pagHtml = '';
  pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" ${currentPage === 1 ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="changePage(${currentPage - 1})">Prev</button>`;
  
  for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {
    if (i === currentPage) {
      pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary active" style="background: #2563eb; border-color: #2563eb;">${i}</button>`;
    } else {
      if (i === 1 || i === totalPages || Math.abs(i - currentPage) <= 1) {
        pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" onclick="changePage(${i})">${i}</button>`;
      } else if (i === 2 || i === totalPages - 1) {
        pagHtml += `<span class="text-muted px-1">...</span>`;
      }
    }
  }

  pagHtml += `<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-primary" ${currentPage === totalPages ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="changePage(${currentPage + 1})">Next</button>`;
  
  paginationContainer.innerHTML = pagHtml.replace(/(<span class="text-muted px-1">\.\.\.<\/span>\s*){2,}/g, '<span class="text-muted px-1">...</span>');
}

function changePage(page) {
  currentPage = page;
  renderTableData();
  document.getElementById('past-papers-table-container').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
}

function applyFilters() {
  let filtered = pastPapersDb;

  if (currentSelectedYear) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(item => item.year.toString() === currentSelectedYear);
  }
  if (currentSelectedGrade) {
    filtered = filtered.filter(item => item.level.toLowerCase() === currentSelectedGrade.toLowerCase());
  }

  const exams = {};
  filtered.forEach(item => {
    const key = `${item.year}_${item.level}`;
    if (!exams[key]) {
      exams[key] = {
        year: item.year,
        level: item.level,
        qp: null,
        ms: null
      };
    }
    if (item.doc_type === 'question') {
      exams[key].qp = item.link;
    } else if (item.doc_type === 'scoring-key') {
      exams[key].ms = item.link;
    }
  });

  filteredExams = Object.values(exams);
  filteredExams.sort((a, b) => {
    if (a.year !== b.year) return parseInt(b.year) - parseInt(a.year);
    return a.level.localeCompare(b.level);
  });

  const container = document.getElementById('past-papers-table-container');
  if (filteredExams.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<p style="padding: 1rem; text-align: center; color: #9ca3af;"><i class="bi bi-info-circle"></i> No matching past papers found.</p>';
    return;
  }

  container.innerHTML = `
    <div class="table-wrapper">
      <table class="premium-table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Year</th>
            <th>Grade Level</th>
            <th style="text-align: center; width: 80px;">Question Paper</th>
            <th style="text-align: center; width: 80px;">Scoring Key</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="past-papers-table-body">
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-center align-items-center gap-2 mt-3" id="pagination-controls"></div>
  `;

  currentPage = 1;
  renderTableData();
}

function selectYearDropdown() {
  const yearSelect = document.getElementById('filter-year');
  currentSelectedYear = yearSelect.value || '';
  applyFilters();
}

function selectGrade(button) {
  currentSelectedGrade = button.getAttribute('data-grade') || '';

  const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.smart-grade-btn');
  buttons.forEach(btn => {
    btn.classList.remove('btn-primary', 'active');
    btn.classList.add('btn-outline-secondary');
  });
  button.classList.remove('btn-outline-secondary');
  button.classList.add('btn-primary', 'active');

  applyFilters();
}

async function initPastPapersTable() {
  const container = document.getElementById('past-papers-table-container');
  const db = await loadPastPapersDb();
  
  if (!db || db.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = '<p><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" style="color: #ef4444;"></i> Error: Failed to load past papers database. Please try again later.</p>';
    return;
  }

  populateYearDropdown(db);
  applyFilters();
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  initPastPapersTable();
});
</script>
```
:::
